payload.text: Determinism rule — `norm_pdf` computes the standard-normal density as `INV_SQRT_2PI * exp(-0.5 * x * x)` where `exp` is the crate's `libm`-backed wrapper, so the transcendental is correctly-rounded and bit-identical across platforms (docs/INTERFACES.md cross-platform determinism). The argument is symmetric in x (x·x), so norm_pdf is exactly even. f64 is the CPU-canonical type. Pure: maps one f64 to one f64, no side effects.
